categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the development, production, and sales of stainless steel fasteners and stainless steel wire products. Its main business units include Zhejiang Tongming Stainless Steel Products Co., Ltd. and Zhejiang Tonghe Stainless Steel Materials Co., Ltd., focusing on manufacturing stainless steel screws, nuts, threaded rods, and wire materials. Subsidiaries also operate in international trade and distribution, serving markets in China, the US, Europe, Japan, and other regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cold forging and stamping technologies, combined with automated production equipment and Oracle ERP systems for production scheduling and management. It has developed proprietary manufacturing processes such as high-strength heat-resistant stainless steel bolts, one-time threading technology for stainless steel threaded rods, and eccentric vibration wire tensioning processes. The company emphasizes continuous process improvements, quality control, and environmental management certifications like ISO 50001 and ISO 45001.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include distributors, industrial manufacturers, and end-users in sectors such as construction, machinery, energy, telecommunications, food processing, transportation, aerospace, and electronics. The company’s products are widely used in infrastructure, automotive, aerospace, and renewable energy industries. The primary market is China, accounting for over 70% of sales, with significant exports to the Americas, Asia, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive branch offices and warehouses across major regions including East China, South China, North China, and Central China. It also has subsidiaries and trading offices in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan, Samoa, and the Cayman Islands. Its sales and distribution network covers domestic Chinese markets and international markets such as the US, Europe, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the stainless steel supply chain, manufacturing stainless steel fasteners and wire products from stainless steel coil and wire rod raw materials. It sources raw materials from upstream steel mills and supplies finished products downstream to distributors and end customers. It also integrates distribution channels and e-commerce platforms to enhance downstream market reach.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value-added stainless steel fasteners such as high-strength heat-resistant bolts and specialized threading technologies for photovoltaic applications. The company focuses on process innovation, production efficiency, and expanding product variety. It invests in R&D to improve product quality, environmental sustainability, and digital integration of supply chain and sales channels. The company aims to strengthen its market leadership in China and expand global presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of stainless steel fasteners and wire products. The company sells through multiple channels including direct sales, distributors, and e-commerce platforms. It also derives income from international trade subsidiaries handling exports and imports. The revenue model is based on volume shipments combined with pricing strategies responsive to raw material costs and market demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the Chinese stainless steel fastener and wire market, holding over 30% market share in 300-series stainless steel standard fasteners domestically. Competitors include other large-scale stainless steel fastener manufacturers in China such as Tengzhou Tengda and Zhejiang Aozhan. The company differentiates itself through scale, integrated production and distribution, advanced technology, and a strong brand presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$12.5 billion with a net profit of NT$579 million, showing significant profit growth despite a slight revenue decline due to lower raw material prices. The company has a large production capacity exceeding 120,000 tons annually and employs over 1,200 staff. It has demonstrated steady growth in shipment volumes and profitability, supported by operational scale and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, corrosion-resistant, and high-strength stainless steel fasteners and wire products with environmental sustainability credentials. It offers a comprehensive product range with advanced manufacturing technologies and proprietary innovations. Its integrated production and distribution network ensures timely delivery and customer service excellence. The company’s scale, technological leadership, and strong market presence provide competitive advantages in pricing, quality, and service.
